title: Vektra Laws conformance results
description: Results of running one conformance suite against one system under test. Informative format; the rules are in ADOPT.md. tools/validate.py --results checks a file against this format and against the suite (every case listed once, case ids exist, reasons for not_applicable, host duties for component scope, no failed case under a 'tested' claim).

system.description: Name of the system under test.

laws_lock_sha256.description: SHA-256 from core/LAWS.lock for the Laws version tested (0.6.0 and later). validate.py checks that it matches; a mismatch means the Laws tested were changed.

claim.description: 'tested' with scope 'component' is the claim 'Tested (component scope)'.

host_duties_not_covered.description: Component scope only. Each duty of the host that the component does not cover.

result.description: pass: the system behaved as the case requires (like a PASS case, unlike a FAIL case).

reason.description: Required for not_applicable: at least four words saying why.
